intent: validation screen for the frozen model-only v2 composite masks and arithmetic; not a model promotion, not an accuracy claim, not an upload

scope.candidate_note: The assembled model-only v2 candidate CSV is not generated yet (bias-est-v2-assembly-probe is open). Until it exists the audit compares the composite emitted by the repository's own frozen combiners against an independent recomputation. Passing --candidate PATH switches the same checks onto the generated candidate score column with no other change.

provided_strata.role: provided ACS strata covariates used only to recompute the frozen fixed-prior presence probability

poi_component.implementation: scripts/estimator_v2_establishments.py and scripts/estimate_gaps.py v2 facility-miss functions

facility_family.urbanity: pct_urban when finite, else pop_urban/pop_total for positive population, else neutral 0.5
facility_family.probability: sigmoid(intercept + log_density * density_index + urban_fraction * urbanity), logit clamped to [-30, 30]
facility_family.gap: probability * clip(1 - n / (n + 1), 0, 1) with n the Overture count after the fixed unclassified allocation

poi.combiner: equal-weight mean of the defined facility and establishments halves

composite.rule: arithmetic mean of the top-level components whose model-defined flag is 1; undefined components are excluded entirely
composite.zero_defined_rule_note: No zero-defined fallback rule is registered. Acceptance requires zero such rows; a nonzero count fails the audit rather than silently emitting a placeholder.

numeric_precision.policy: each re-derived component value is counted as exact when format(value, '.12g') reproduces the artifact field (or the parsed field equals it bit for bit); every other row must fall within the registered serialization floor, which is the accumulated decimal-round-trip of the 12-significant-digit artifact fields and their inputs. The audit reports exact-match rows, last-digit near-miss rows, floor violations and the measured maximum residual per component.

prohibitions.notes: The audit reads only official sample GEOIDs, provided strata covariates, and already-frozen provided-feature component artifacts. config/calibration.json (the only LB-calibrated constant source) is never opened by this script; cbp_k and the presence priors are the model-derived constants frozen in this file.
